risiko.csv: host;cvss;erreichbarkeit (in: risiko.csv: host;cvss;erreichbarkeit (reachability: internet=2, intern=1 = internal). Risk = CVSS × reachability. Which host has the highest risk?
Bash only calculates with whole numbers. tr -d . turns 8.1 into 81 – the ratio stays the same.
Zeile für Zeile: grep -v host risiko.csv: Line by line: grep -v host risiko.csv | while read z; do …; done – get the fields with cut.
Lösung: grep -v host risiko.csv | while: Solution: grep -v host risiko.csv | while read z; do c=$(echo $z | cut -d';' -f2 | tr -d .); e=$(echo $z | cut -d';' -f3); echo "$((c*e)) $(echo $z | cut -d';' -f1)"; done | sort -nr | head -1 → cat befunde/vpn.txt
